answer: Re-attestations are stored in karst and ocean lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the relic graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1997 impostors cost 500 times the honest price and take 11 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
